entries.docsFastPathRange: Terminal metadata records the latest eligible immutable base/head comparison on the same leased base branch; live gates precede attestation recording on every transport attempt. Record failures are deferred with exitCode, signal, stderrTail (redacted, at most 2000 characters), error, retryAfter, needsOperator and parkReason. entries.recoveryCustodyTable: recovery_custody(head TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, deadline TEXT, observed INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL)
entries.recoveryCustodyContract: RECOVERYSTALL-01: each expired R04 execution re-reads exact-head lease and referenced launch/retry custody, revalidates the observed lease after yielding, and atomically increments durable attempts with deadline, observation time and last JSON evidence. Diagnostic only; directory/open/schema/write/close failures warn and return refreshed custody without a durable attempt record. Normal per-PR intent lock and lease CAS own retirement/replacement. No pruning. Pipeline health reads custody only after selecting its oldest 50 expired items; aggregates retain all entries.
entries.recoveryReminderContract: closure-recovery-deadline opts into six-hour reminders using additive nullable last_paged, migrated under an immediate transaction. A legacy paged row without a timestamp is eligible immediately. Reservation preserves started/deadline, appends its timestamp to the delivery dedup key, and refunds previous values on failure only while current. Other classes remain once-only.
entries.decisionMismatchCycleTable: decision_mismatch_cycle(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), head TEXT NOT NULL, cycles INTEGER NOT NULL)
entries.decisionMismatchCycleContract: First consumed mismatch permits one re-resolution; the second at the same head pages through closure-decision-mismatch and returns closure-decision-mismatch-escalated. Count saturates at two, survives restart, queue submissions and decision changes; a different head starts count one. No completion reset. Existing per-PR/head page receipt dedupes and refunds failed delivery.
entries.refreshCycleTable: refresh_cycle(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), head TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, cycles INTEGER NOT NULL)
entries.refreshCycleContract: Three unchanged settled snapshot-refresh outcomes page with the stored decline through the existing per-PR/head receipt. Fingerprints canonicalize object keys and label/check-rollup/required-context/detail-reason ordering, retain all entry fields and other array order, and exclude older-head decline reasons and details. The encoding change can restart existing counters once at deployment without clearing receipts. Head/fact change starts count one; settled non-refresh deletes the counter; background submission preserves it. Count saturates at three and survives restart/delivery failure. Receipt does not reset with the count.
entries.finalRoundReceiptScope: per PR across heads; independent of primary-change
entries.waitProgress: launch/head progress restarts the deadline before stall evaluation; retained running/starting launch or confirmed dispatched lease timestamps advance existing final-round rows only when no later than observation time; retained succeeded-awaiting-audit-or-merged-signal holds supply no launch progress; running background dispatch uses ephemeral launchWait from actual start for its dispatch timeout (15-minute fallback), preserving original debt on refusal and paging explicitly on overrun
entries.legacyWaitMigration: none; one-time deadline and page-reservation reset
